name: war gauntlets
_design_note: F50-100 heavy hand slot. Articulated fingers + knuckle plate. Pairs with plate / full plate body.
lore_template: A pair of {material_name} war gauntlets with every finger separately jointed and a ridge of plate across the knuckles. They spread a hammer blow over the whole hand. Smiths covet them for the forge, where they are merely useful.
